key_insight: FICE is the first fully inductive learned cardinality estimator for SPARQL Basic Graph Patterns, able to generalize to unseen graphs and relations without retraining.
engineering_relevance: It targets real triplestores by making cardinality estimation fast enough for sub-millisecond inference while staying robust to graph changes.
method: Encoder GNN builds entity and relation embeddings from a local factor-graph view of the knowledge graph.
Decoder GNN composes these embeddings along the query join structure to predict log-cardinality.
Joint training and neighborhood sampling make the model scalable to million-triple knowledge graphs.
evidence_signal: Across 10 knowledge graphs, FICE reduced median q-error to 5.34 versus 13.54 for the best competitor and showed stronger tail performance.
watch_item: The approach depends on graph-neighborhood message passing and joint encoder-decoder training, so deployment may require careful tuning for very large or highly dynamic graphs.
